slides.title: Start with one job
slides.body: Pick the job that hurts most, like stock or billing. Move that first, and add the rest once it works.

slides.title: Clean your lists first
slides.body: Tidy your item list, party list and opening stock. These are what get loaded into the new system.

slides.title: Run both for a short while
slides.body: Keep the old sheet for a few weeks and check the totals match. Fix any gaps before you switch.

slides.title: Make the system the only place
slides.body: Train the people who enter data, then stop using the sheet for that job. One screen, one set of numbers.

post.instagram_caption:
Want to leave Excel without stopping work? Save this.

You do not have to change everything on one day. Move one job at a time, load clean lists, and check the numbers before you switch. For a small plant, our setup usually takes two to four weeks, including loading items, parties and opening stock and training the team.

4 steps: start with one job, clean your lists first, run both for a short while, then make the system the only place for that job.

Try a live demo with sample data at resolveai.cc, no sign-up.

Source: ResolveAI product pages and FAQ.
